input.answer:
The all-items Consumer Price Index for Ontario (not seasonally adjusted, 2002=100 basis as published in StatCan table 18-10-0004) was 170.3 in September 2026.

Context: August 2026 was 170.0, so the change was 170.3 − 170.0 = +0.3 points, or 0.3 / 170.0 × 100 = +0.2% month over month (computed from the published index values, not a StatCan-published rate).

Source: Statistics Canada Table 18-10-0004, Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted (Geography: Ontario; Products: All-items).
